description: Sync every row of the Smartsheet sheets you choose, one searchable document per row. Smartsheet sharing is not imported.
opening: Sync every row of the Smartsheet sheets you select. Each row is one document, with each non-empty cell written as a column-and-value line.

Smartsheet sharing is not imported, so every synced row is visible to everyone who can query the collection unless you set an access rule. Attachments and discussions are not synced. Rows deleted in Smartsheet stay in HydraDB.

notes: Smartsheet sharing is not reproduced. Set an access rule on each sheet that should be restricted.

connect.auth: Smartsheet uses an API access token.

credentials.name: smartsheet_access_token
credentials.text: A Smartsheet API access token for a user who can read the sheets.

steps.title: Generate a token
steps.text: In Smartsheet, generate an API access token for a user who can view the sheets you want.

steps.title: Select sheets
steps.text: HydraDB lists the sheets the token can read. Select the sheets to sync. Each row of a selected sheet becomes one document.

connect.account: One connector reads the sheets one token's Smartsheet user can view.

sync.first_sync: A newly selected sheet reads back the window set by `lookback_days`, 30 days by default, measured on when rows were last modified.
sync.changes: Each sync reads the rows modified since the last sync.
sync.edits: A row with a changed cell is read again and updates the same document.
sync.deletes: Deleted rows are not removed. A row deleted in Smartsheet stays searchable in HydraDB.

documents.name: Rows
documents.one_document: One row of a selected sheet.
documents.title: The first non-empty cell in a column named `name`, `title`, `subject` or `task name`, in any case, taking columns in alphabetical order. Otherwise the first other non-empty value. Otherwise the sheet name and `row`.
documents.text: The title, then one `Column: value` line per non-empty cell, with columns in alphabetical order, not sheet order. Cross-sheet references and predecessors appear as cell text.
documents.date: When the row was last modified.
documents.link_back: The sheet that holds the row, not the row itself.

attributes.name: Cells
attributes.text: Every non-empty cell, as `Column: value`. Columns are not individual query filters. Contact and assignee columns are text only, not people in the graph.

attributes.name: modified_at
attributes.text: When the row was last modified. Sets the result date and decides when a sync picks the row up. Not searchable.

attributes.name: additional_metadata.smartsheet_sheet
attributes.text: The sheet name in snake case, such as `project_tracker`. Limits a query to one sheet's rows. Different sheet names can end up with the same value, so it is not a unique sheet id. Not searchable.

attributes.name: connector_id
attributes.text: Limits a query to this connector's rows. Not searchable.

attributes.name: row_id
attributes.text: The numeric row id. Together with the sheet, it decides which document a later sync updates.

example_searches: Which rows in the Project Tracker sheet are marked At Risk?
What is the due date and owner of the Vendor onboarding task?
Which rows in the Hiring Plan sheet changed this week?

connections: Each row is grouped under its sheet. Sheets are not items of their own.
No links between rows or to other tools. Cross-sheet references and predecessors are cell text only.
graph.people: No people are attached to rows. Contact and assignee columns are text only.
graph.from_text: All cell values of each row.

not_synced: Cell formatting, formulas and column-type details. Only cell values are kept.
Deletions: deleted rows stay in HydraDB.
